g.text: Uploader retry loop fixed: backoff now resets aft…
Uploader retry loop fixed: backoff now resets after a success
Search ranks recent sessions higher with a 90-day…
Uploads of large session files stalled for hours after a single network blip. The
retry delay doubled on every failure but never went back down, so one bad night
left the queue waiting 6 hours between attempts. The fix resets the backoff after
any successful upload and caps it at 10 minutes.
Reset the backoff after any success; cap it at 600 seconds.
A stuck queue hides newer sessions from every agent.
Why did uploads stall for hours?
✔ Nothing newer: this is the latest word.
